**Not a regression: this also reproduces on the released 18.0.0 console.**

I reproduced it on the prebuilt `@objectstack/console@18.0.0` from npm. Its `dist/.objectui-sha` is `616df6598b429d2b3687301a2041198928e68971`. I served it same-origin, in front of the same objectstack `main` showcase backend, and signed in as the dev admin. Both sequences in the issue crash it the same way (2/2), with the same `pageerror: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'forEach')`.

Between `616df6598` and `6fb31dcc9`:
- The record-group block in `CommandPalette.tsx` is unchanged. The only edits there are the `onSelect` handlers moving to `confirmUnsavedLeave` (#13265).
- `packages/components/src/ui/command.tsx` is unchanged.
- The lockfile pins `cmdk@1.1.1` in both.

The per-object record groups (`key={`records:${group.objectName}`}`) were added in 8ecf5a69e (#2772, 2026-07-21), when the palette started showing `/api/v1/search` hits. That is most likely where the crash comes from. I have not bisected it build by build.

Triage: lands in `apps/console` `CommandPalette.tsx` (the per-object `records:<objectName>` `CommandGroup`s) plus an error boundary around the palette in the shell; rationale: ordinary use of ⌘K (changing the query) unmounts the whole console. Not a regression: the filer reproduced it on the released 18.0.0 console (`.objectui-sha` 616df6598), most likely since #2772 added per-object record groups. Two parts: make the async record groups bypass cmdk's own sort/filter (or keep them stable across queries), and contain any palette failure so it cannot take the shell down.

Plan, as the triage comment scopes it:
1. The palette already matches every entry it renders itself (`matchesPaletteQuery`), and record hits come ranked from `/api/v1/search`, so cmdk's own filter and sort are turned off (`shouldFilter={false}`). The crash is cmdk's sort walking a group id that an unmounted per-object group has already removed; with its filter off that sort never runs.
2. A palette failure is contained: an error boundary around the palette closes it and leaves the shell mounted, so the next ⌘K opens a fresh one.
3. A test reproduces the query switch between two different record-group sets.
